name: Worldforged epic ranks open after Hakkar and item level 70 waits for Ragnaros
contract: The live LootCollector WorldforgedUpgrades ladder names the first epic rank (item level 64 or 67) the Zul'Gurub
upgrade and item level 70 the Molten Core (Tier 1) upgrade (user decision 2026-11-04). Flesh Flayer Hook 278843
(blue, item level 59, no dungeon variant) upgrades to 1378062 (item level 67, store key 4, 3926 Runes of
Ascension). Junglewood Recurve 1389875, a level 60 blue dungeon variant, upgrades to 1379880 (item level 67, key 2,
3926 runes) and then to 1381880 (item level 70, key 1381880). Decayed Breeches 1389233, also a level 60 blue
dungeon variant, upgrades to 1379719 (item level 64, key 1569, 5000 runes). Before Hakkar falls every epic
purchase names Hakkar and takes nothing; afterwards the item level 64 and 67 ranks are sold for their price, and
the item level 70 rank names Ragnaros and takes nothing.
